answer_2.quote: We utilize VQAScore as the raw VLM-only baseline... We compare VQAScore as the baseline with Caption Score which represents an exact match of generated tokens while VisualGPTScore considers the exact match of the generated sequence.

answer_3.quote: We utilize a large multimodal model (GPT-4o) as the 'judge' to assign entailment scores given a constructed rule.

answer_4.quote: We perform a 100-sample human study with 10 different humans, each of whom is given 10 samples... We ask every participant 2 questions for each concept -Q1: 'Given {concept node}, do you think it may happen simultaneously with {root node} or not related at all?' and Q2: 'Given {concept node}, do you think it is similar to {parent node} or not related at all?'.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked two binary questions per concept: (Q1) whether the concept may happen simultaneously with the root node, and (Q2) whether the concept is similar to its parent node.
